metas.name: Ready or Not
metas.description: A new bride's wedding night turns into a deadly game of hide-and-seek with her rich in-laws. It's a pitch-black comedy thriller about a polite family that goes along with something monstrous, and it is funny and tense all the way through.

metas.name: Marty Supreme
metas.description: A hustler chasing table-tennis glory careens from one bad decision to the next. The anxiety never lets up, it's often very funny, and there's always something at stake.

metas.name: Clayface
metas.description: A rising Hollywood star loses his face and his identity to a scientific experiment and turns into a monster bent on revenge. Body horror and a revenge story in one, with an unsparing look at vanity and fame.

metas.name: The Handmaiden
metas.description: Park Chan-wook's lush, erotic con-game thriller set in 1930s Korea, where a maid and an heiress play a long game of double-crosses against the men scheming over them. Twisted, beautifully controlled, and built toward a deeply satisfying revenge payoff.

metas.name: The Vanishing
metas.description: A Dutch thriller about a man searching for his missing girlfriend and the calm, ordinary family man who took her. The film tightens slowly to one of the most chilling endings ever filmed.

metas.name: Match Point
metas.description: An ambitious tennis instructor marries into London money, and he is ready to do something monstrous to keep it. Woody Allen's darkest film plays it straight, and its ending is morally sickening.

metas.name: I Saw the Devil
metas.description: A secret agent hunts the serial killer who murdered his fiancée, then lets him go so he can catch him again and make him suffer. Kim Jee-woon's revenge thriller keeps escalating and asks what the hunt turns the hunter into.

metas.name: Headhunters
metas.description: A smug corporate recruiter who steals art on the side robs the wrong man, and the job becomes a hunt for his life. A tight, nasty Norwegian thriller that keeps getting worse for him, with a payoff that clicks into place.

metas.name: Blue Ruin
metas.description: A drifter carries out a clumsy act of revenge and then has to deal with the family that comes after him. It's quiet and grim, and the violence is awkward and frightening, with every step making things worse.

metas.name: Green Room
metas.description: A punk band sees a murder at a neo-Nazi bar and is trapped in the green room while the owners plan how to get rid of them. Jeremy Saulnier's siege thriller is relentless, with sudden violence and real stakes.
